remarks: Experience luxury style living in the highly sought-after community of Marlborough Country Villas 1 in beautiful Wood Ranch. Located just moments away from the Wood Ranch Golf Club, this beautifully maintained, one-owner townhome offers 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms of pristine living space. Step inside to find rich wood flooring, and elegant crown molding, recessed lighting. The cozy living room features a classic brick fireplace and custom wood shutters, carpeting, flowing seamlessly into a dining area that opens to a light, bright atrium.
